payload.purpose_context: Operators and agent harnesses isolate mission work in a linked, explicitly owned checkout. Today creation works but status, planning, work-package context, runtime next, task finalization and review silently resolve against the primary checkout, fail, or return wrong results. This mission makes the validated owned checkout the single authority for every lifecycle read (issues #3449, #5026, #4252, #4867, #5277).
payload.purpose_tldr: Make a mission created in an explicitly owned checkout runnable end to end without any read or write leaking to the primary checkout.

options: Owned checkout wins silently (primary copy ignored)
Owned checkout wins, emit a warning naming the stale primary copy
Refuse with a typed conflict error until the operator removes one copy
payload.question: When a validated owned checkout holds the mission AND the primary checkout also holds a (stale) copy of the same mission, what should owned-checkout lifecycle reads do?
Confirm the Intent Summary for the owned-checkout lifecycle authority mission (actor, trigger, outcome, invariants, scope in/out).

payload.final_answer: Owned checkout wins, emit a warning naming the stale primary copy

payload.question: Owned next on coordination topologies (lanes_with_coord): keep or refuse?

payload.final_answer: Keep + harden: single minter records topology; each command enforces its allowed topologies (ADR 2026-09-03-1 lifecycle commands single_branch-only); FR-011 hardens the coordination probe with deterministic fault injection.

payload.question: What should flagless commands do when run inside a linked checkout once implicit cwd adoption is retired?

payload.final_answer: Validated auto-adoption: keep adopting the current linked checkout but only through the canonical ownership validator; repository root checkout, lane and coordination worktrees keep today's behaviour; amend ADR 2026-08-12-1.

payload.question: Supported path to implement and review an owned WP?

payload.final_answer: next --owned-checkout issues implement and review prompts with workspace = owned checkout; lane transitions via move-task --owned-checkout; implement/action review get --owned-checkout that refuses with a typed code pointing at that path; success criteria extend through claim, for_review and review prompt.

payload.question: How far to convert the 92 bare effective_root: Path parameters to the OwnedCheckout fact?

payload.final_answer: Convert all 92 in-mission (runtime, mission_runtime and specify_cli); gate bans bare-path owned-root params everywhere in src with an empty allowlist.

payload.question: Carrier shape: rename to mission_runtime.OwnedCheckout or move OwnedMission keeping names?

payload.final_answer: Rename to mission_runtime.OwnedCheckout (repository_root, owned_root, mission_dir, mission_slug, topology, target_branch); delete OwnedMission with no alias; bulk edit with occurrence map.

payload.question: Fix subject-matching review base for all missions or owned only?

payload.final_answer: Unify for all: one claim_commit_for_wp helper (claim event_id -> git log -S, fail closed) for owned and repository-root review; delete the three subject matchers.

payload.question: Staging of signature migration across WPs?

payload.final_answer: Temporary dual keyword (owned= plus effective_root=) on the six shared seams from the seam WP until a closing WP deletes effective_root everywhere; closing WP commits the gate red then green.

payload.question: Campsite scope for accept() (C901=59) and _create_mission_core_impl (40) hidden behind per-file ignores?

payload.final_answer: Fully decompose both to <=15 behaviour-preserving with focused tests and remove their per-file C901 ignores.
